description: This file defines interfaces and classes related to selecting codecs and copiers for serialization and copying in the Orleans framework. It includes interfaces for codec and copier selection, as well as delegate-based implementations.

classes.name: DelegateCodecSelector
classes.description: A sealed class implementing ICodecSelector that uses a delegate to determine support for types.

classes.name: DelegateCopierSelector
classes.description: A sealed class implementing ICopierSelector that uses a delegate to determine support for types.

methods.name: IsSupportedType
methods.description: Determines if a given type is supported by the selector, delegating the decision to a provided function.

methods.name: CodecName
methods.description: Property returning the well-known name of the codec.

methods.name: CopierName
methods.description: Property returning the well-known name of the copier.
